The other day I was thinking about how to improve the quality of the comments where at Reddit most commenters try to be funny or use a quick pun to get quick upvotes. This behavior make these comments come up the top since most users will upvote anything that make them laugh or a clever pun which add almost nothing to the discussion. This usually pushes real discussions to the bottom where they are not seen all the time and can easily be buried.

The idea would be for a way where users would be able to categorize each comment in different pre-set categories. For example, the categories could be Insightful, Descriptive, Complementary, Funny/Pun or Flamebait. Once a comment has a majority categorization it would be tagged with that category and the regular system of voting up and down would take over. The moderators of each verse could assign an up and down value for each category. For example, on the funny verses, the Funny Category would be an upvote, where in a News verse it would be assigned a Downvote.

Anyways, just an idea. Keep up the good work Atko

I liked this feature on Slashdot back in the day. Though I don’t know if it would promote “real discussion” to the top, as I would prefer to view comments by score anyway (i.e. I would want to see the top-scoring comments regardless of category, and if it’s a Funny then so be it.)
